entities.summary: Luisa Haydee Cervera Cevedon, more commonly known as Luisa Cervera, is a former Peruvian volleyball player. Cervera received a silver medal at the 1988 Olympic Games in Seoul, after playing the Soviet Union in the final. She also participated in the 1984 Olympic Games in Los Angeles, where Peru reached the semifinals and lost to the United States, finishing fourth.
